title: { 1, DATE(2017, 1, 1), TRUE, "A" } is a string column: the date becomes 1/1/2017

source.quote: Returns the following table of a single column of String data type
source.supports: the example { 1, DATE(2017, 1, 1), TRUE, "A" } is shown returning 1, 1/1/2017, TRUE, A as strings

source.quote: all values are converted to a common data type
source.supports: mixed types in one column are converted to one type

notes: The page is the only published output found of a date converted to text without FORMAT: month/day/year with no leading zeros and no time part. It also shows 1 as "1" and TRUE as "TRUE".
